title: Non-Covered Visit Terms by Payer Program (Insured Plan of Care)
content:
Under the **Insured Plan of Care**, a visit the payer will not cover can be billed to the patient only on the terms of the payer program the plan is billed under. The terms below govern the advance financial-responsibility form, whether such billing is allowed at all, the self-pay visit rate and whether the payer's calendar-year visit limit is shared with other therapies.

| Payer program | Advance financial-responsibility form | Non-covered billing allowed | Self-pay visit rate | Visit limit shared with occupational and speech therapy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | Commercial non-covered services waiver | Yes | $118.00 | Yes |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | Commercial non-covered services waiver | Yes | $118.00 | Yes |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | Commercial non-covered services waiver | Yes | $118.00 | Yes |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | Commercial non-covered services waiver | Yes | $118.00 | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (ABN) | Yes | $118.00 | No |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | None | No | $118.00 | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | None | No | $118.00 | Yes |

## What each term means

- **Advance financial-responsibility form** — the form used before a non-covered visit: the Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (ABN), the commercial non-covered services waiver, or none.
- **Non-covered billing allowed** — whether a visit the payer will not cover may be billed to the patient when the waiver form was signed before the visit.
- **Self-pay visit rate** — the payer program's self-pay visit rate for one non-covered visit, $118.00 on every payer program.
- **Visit limit shared** — whether the payer's calendar-year visit limit is shared with occupational and speech therapy visits reported elsewhere.

## Terms as they read for each kind of program

- *Commercial programs (PPO, High-Deductible, POS, HMO):* the commercial non-covered services waiver; non-covered billing allowed; limit shared with occupational and speech therapy.
- *Medicare Part B:* the ABN; non-covered billing allowed; the visit limit is not shared with occupational and speech therapy.
- *Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Managed Care:* no form exists and non-covered billing is not allowed.
